_how_to: Tolerance thresholds used by the scoring step. Edit, save, deploy, then update the scorecard for the month.
basis 'Policy': fixed Green tolerance and Red limit, in the metric's unit.

basis 'Prevailing median' (owner, 3 Nov 2026: always calculated from the month's own data, never a static starting value): the Green tolerance is the median of the families' results that month (the middle family, so one unusual family can't drag it); the Red limit is the Green tolerance plus or minus the Amber band. The band is 1.5 x the usual spread between families (the middle half, once 4 or more families have a result), and never less than the metric's minimum band (5 points by default). Each month stands alone. With no family results there is no threshold and the metric isn't scored.
Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_firm_tolerance: Where we want the firm's TRUST score to be. Leave null until the Head of Tech Risk and the CTO agree a number; the CTO view then shows the line and how far the firm is from it.
_caps: Score caps (owner, 3 Nov 2026): automatic_red_block = the most a building block can score when an automatic Red rule applies (e.g. TE-02 client impact); red_metric_block = the most a block can score with any Red metric; red_block_trust = the most a TRUST score can score with any Red block. Whole numbers 0-100. A change applies when a month is next updated; locked months keep the caps they were sealed with.
_coverage: Owner, 4 Nov 2026: how much has to be measured before a score shows. block_min_share = the share of a building block's arrived metrics that must be scored (0 = any one scored metric; the original rule was 0.5). trust_min_blocks = scored blocks needed for a TRUST score (1 = any scored block; the original rule was 3). To go back: 0.5 and 3, deploy, then update the month. Locked months keep the rules they were scored with.
_min_families_for_threshold: Owner, 4 Nov 2026: a tolerance threshold worked out from the prevailing median needs at least this many families with a result; with fewer, the metric shows No tolerance threshold yet and isn't scored that month. Policy thresholds (like RE-02) don't need it.
_automatic_red_rules: Owner, 9 Nov 2026: automatic Red rules are off for now. Today the only one built is TE-02's: a release with client impact (Status Client) makes the result Red and caps the Releases block at 49. true = on again; the cards then show their Automatic Red row. Client-impact releases are still counted and shown either way. Deploy, then update the month.
_behind_peers_flag: Owner, 8 Nov 2026: the Behind peers flag is off for now (every measured metric uses the prevailing median, whose colours already compare each family with the median). true = flag Policy metrics again (a family at least the card's gap worse than the median family, 5 families needed) and show the Flags section on cards. Deploy, then update the month.
_switched_on: Owner, 4 Nov 2026: metrics that are counted from their files and only scored when listed here. TR-02 = repo hygiene from the GitHub repo file; RE-01 = Tier 0/1 DR test completed and RE-03 = resiliency tests passed, both from the ITDR application and DR tests files. TR-01 = repo mapping rate from the GitHub repo file and the app inventory (owner, 6 Nov 2026). Remove one to switch it off (it then shows Not switched on yet), deploy, then update the month.
